CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting

  May 11, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  •  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

There were six (6) records of meeting minutes on the consent calendar.
MOTION:
  •  Chiu moved to approve the application with the condition that the gutters proposed be
  removed or that the leader hat be reduced in size.
  •  Chiu made the motion to approve the consent agenda.
  •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried unanimously.

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 729 South 7th Street

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.
The applicant: Eric Tsang was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Chiu supported the project.
Hernandez questioned the roof pitch and the applicant confirmed that the pitch was less than 4:12.
Udani questioned the garage door and confirmed that the door will be grey consistent with the
material board. The garage door is not visible from the street. He also led a discussion on the gutters
and downspouts. The architect stated that he would use the smallest standard size or would remove
them.

  1
 Chiu moved to approve the application with the condition that the gutters proposed be removed or
that the leader hat be reduced in size.
Hernandez seconded the motion.
The motion was approved unanimously.

MOTION:
 •  Chiu moved to approve the application with the condition that the gutters proposed be
  removed or that the leader hat be reduced in size.
 •  The second was by Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez.

ITEM 2:
APPLICANT: 1216 West Main Street
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

The applicant: Lucie Lee was present for Item number 2 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Applicant for item number one gave a brief presentation and acknowledged the staff comments.

Board discussion began on the item.

Applicant for item number one gave a brief presentation and acknowledged that there are roll up
doors (4) behind an existing brick wall. There will also be parking lot striping. Discussion ensued
and these items are not in need of Design Review.

Chiu stated that she was in support of those items and did not need review. The Board concurred.

Hernandez supported the revisions.

Udani also concurred with the other members.

Hernandez moved to approve the application as submitted.
Chiu seconded the motion.

The motion was approved unanimously.

MOTION:
Hernandez moved to approve the application as submitted.
 •  The second was by Chiu
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

  2
 Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez.

ITEM 3:
APPLICANT: 2033 South 3rd Street
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for continuance to allow the applicant to redesign the
proposal with a material and configuration more consistent with the style of the home.

The applicant was absent.
Chiu moved to continue the item, Hernandez seconds and the motion is approved unanimously.

MOTION:
Chiu moved to continue the item.
  • The second was by Hernandez.
  • The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez.

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
Chiu moved to adjourn at 7:50, Hernandez seconds and the motion carries unanimously
  •  Chiu moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:50
  •  Seconded by Hernandez
 •  The motion carried unanimously

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez.

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
